description: This file bootstraps a preview healthcheck server in a Node environment before Expo web starts. It sets default environment variables, constructs a small ESM runner that dynamically imports and starts the healthcheck server module, and spawns a child process to execute this runner. The code also handles errors during this process.

methods.name: main
methods.description: The main function that sets environment variables, constructs the runner script, and spawns a child process to execute it.
